spots.name: Awatovi
spots.tip: A landmark with history. Low light brings out texture; check opening hours if it's fenced.

spots.name: Castle Butte
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 1,976 m (6,483 ft).
